verdict.rationale: AutoGen provides GraphFlow, explicitly documented as enabling 'multi-agent workflows through a directed graph of agents,' alongside multiple team constructs (RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat, Swarm) supporting branching, sequential, and coordinated execution patterns, plus AgentTool for composing orchestration setups. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation/examples showing parallel-step execution and loop constructs within GraphFlow, and independent hands-on validation of graph branching/looping behavior beyond docs claims.
